Classification: Public synthetic demonstration data; no passenger or personal data.

Join FLIGHT.carrier_code to CARRIER.code and FLIGHT.tail_nr to AIRCRAFT.tail_nr; each dimension key must be unique.
Never join RUNWAY into a flight aggregate without accounting for multiple runways per airport.
State the metric definition, denominator, units, time window and exclusions with every answer.
Treat results as synthetic demonstrations, not evidence about real airlines or airports.
